name: Undead Brain Collector

generalAbilities.name: Absorb Phantom Brain
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The undead brain collector possesses at least 1 phantom brain after using Brainlash

Effect The undead brain collector absorbs 1d4 of its phantom brains, gaining 1d8 temporary Hit Points for each brain it absorbed.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Brainlash
offensiveAbilities.description:
The undead brain collector extrudes a writhing tangle of ectoplasm from its bursted brain blisters. These ectoplasmic strands lash out at all living targets within 30 feet. Targets in this area must attempt a DC 25 Will Saving Throw save.

After the undead brain collector uses this ability, seven phantom brains glow and shimmer where its brain blisters once were. It can't use Brainlash again until all seven phantom brains are Absorbed.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 4d6 Mental Damage damage.

Failure The creature takes 8d6 Mental Damage damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes 8d6 Mental Damage damage and is Confused.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mind-Rotting Toxin
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw Basic DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d6 Void Damage and Stupefied 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 Void Damage, stupefied 1, and Slowed 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 2d6 Void Damage, Stupefied 2, and slowed 1 (1 round)
